hunks.baseline: At the dim break of dawn, a group of people was making its way through the thick fog.
hunks.sol: In the dim light of early dawn, a group of people was making its way through the thick fog.

hunks.baseline: “Stop whining. It’s more than ninety percent.”
hunks.sol: “Stop whining. It’s ninety percent or more.”

hunks.baseline: The annihilation of the Heavenly Wind Band, which had once made a name for itself throughout the northern Gaoyuan through its brutality. The ninety-percent guess had finally become a hundred-percent certainty.
hunks.sol: The Heavenly Wind Band, which had once made a name for itself across the northern Gaoyuan with its savagery, had been annihilated. The ninety-percent guess had finally become a hundred-percent certainty.

hunks.baseline: Their eyes snapped open at the sudden shout. The two Branch Leaders immediately displayed their movement techniques and ran like the wind. As they arrived, they muttered like men groaning in disbelief.
hunks.sol: Their eyes snapped open at the sudden shout. The two Branch Leaders activated their movement techniques and raced over like the wind. They muttered as if groaning.

hunks.baseline: He soon forced his eyes open, and a dry voice leaked from between his lips.
hunks.sol: He soon forced his eyes open, and a thick, hoarse voice slipped out from between his lips.

hunks.baseline: The strength was too powerful to believe it came from a dying man. The open mouth reeked of death.
hunks.sol: It was a grip too fierce to believe it came from a dying man. The open mouth reeked of death.

hunks.baseline: The horrified Branch Leader hurriedly tried to pull away, but the strength slowly drained from the Heavenly Wind Band Leader’s grip.
hunks.sol: Just as the horrified Branch Leader hurriedly tried to pull free, the strength drained from the Heavenly Wind Band Leader’s grip.

hunks.baseline: “He was an old master in the Supreme Peak realm who primarily used Scorching Yang Qi. Judging by the fact that he didn’t leave a single person alive, he’s merciless as well. If he came this way past Datong, he’d attract attention in no time.”
hunks.sol: “He was an old master in the Supreme Peak realm who primarily used Scorching Yang Qi. Judging by the fact that he didn’t leave a single person alive, he’s merciless as well. If he crossed Datong and came our way, he’d be spotted in no time.”

hunks.baseline: “Ah, this is the road to the village.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, well, this is the road to the village.”

hunks.baseline: The old man devoured the palm-sized rice ball in the blink of an eye. Jang offered him the wooden carrying frame on his back.
hunks.sol: The old man devoured the palm-sized rice ball in the blink of an eye. Jang held out the wooden carrying frame on his back.

hunks.baseline: “Please climb on. If you sit on top of the bundle of firewood, you should be able to make it down comfortably.”
hunks.sol: “Please climb on. If you sit on top of the bundle of firewood, you should be able to ride down without too much trouble.”

hunks.baseline: Jang Family Village began to come into view ahead of him.
hunks.sol: Jang suddenly became much quieter. Jang Family Village began to come into view ahead of him.
